regions.merged_text: "If a fault of any one disturbs you, know that it is more a weakness for him than is for you, & that he suffers more from it. Perhap, however, it is but "a mote in thy brother's eye" which on account of" the beam in thy own," appears so great. At all events have the charity to pray the Lord to deliver thy brother and if the latter be the case, & it will prove a double blessing.

regions.merged_text: Promises of Our Lord Jesus Christ made to Blessed Margret Mary in behalf of those devoted to His. S. Heart. + 1. I will give them all the graces neces- sary for their state of life. 2. I will establish peace in their families. 3. I will console them in all their difficulties. 4. I will be their assured refuge in life and more especially at death. 5. I will pour out abundant benedictions on all their undertakings. 6. Sinners will find in My Heart a boundless ocean of mercy. 7. Tepid souls shall become fervent. 8. Fervent souls shall advance rapidly to great perfection.

regions.merged_text: 9. I will bless the house in which the image of my Heart shall be exposed and honored. 10. I will give to priests the power of touching the hardest hearts. 11. Persons who propagate this devotion shall have their names inscribed in My Heart and they shall never be effaced from It. 12. I promise thee that those who receive communion on the first Friday of nine consecutive months, shall not die under my displeasure.
